courses.title: AI For Everyone
courses.desc: Non-technical introduction to artificial intelligence by Andrew Ng (DeepLearning.AI). Explains what AI can and cannot do, business use-cases, workflows, and ethical/practical considerations — ideal for managers and product people who need a strategic understanding of AI.

courses.title: Machine Learning
courses.desc: Classic practical introduction to machine learning by Andrew Ng covering supervised learning, linear/logistic regression, neural networks, regularization, and best practices for building ML systems. Contains programming exercises and conceptual intuition for practitioners.

courses.title: Deep Learning Specialization
courses.desc: Comprehensive multi-course specialization from DeepLearning.AI covering neural networks, convolutional networks, sequence models, and practical techniques like transfer learning and hyperparameter tuning. Hands-on assignments use TensorFlow and focus on production-ready models.

courses.title: Generative AI with Large Language Models
courses.desc: Focused course on modern generative AI and large language models: architecture basics (transformers), prompt engineering, safety, evaluation, and practical applications like summarization, code generation, and chatbots. Includes labs demonstrating real LLM integrations.

courses.title: Python for Everybody Specialization
courses.desc: Beginner-to-intermediate series by the University of Michigan that teaches Python programming fundamentals, data structures, web scraping, working with APIs, and databases — includes practical projects to build coding confidence for data tasks.

courses.title: IBM Data Science Professional Certificate
courses.desc: Multi-course professional certificate from IBM covering Python for data science, SQL, data visualization, basic machine learning, and capstone projects. Designed to prepare learners for entry-level data roles and portfolio building with hands-on labs.

courses.title: Data Science Specialization (Johns Hopkins)
courses.desc: Comprehensive R-based specialization covering data wrangling, exploratory data analysis, statistical inference, regression models, and reproducible research. Projects and capstones prepare learners for applied data science workflows.

courses.title: Applied Data Science with Python
courses.desc: Practical course series that teaches pandas, matplotlib, scikit-learn, and real-world data workflows for analysis and visualization. Emphasizes applied case studies and end-to-end insights rather than just theory.

courses.title: CS50's Introduction to Computer Science
courses.desc: Harvard's well-known CS50 course: problem solving, algorithms, C, Python, SQL and web programming fundamentals with challenging problem sets and a strong emphasis on computational thinking and project-based learning.

courses.title: Python 3 Programming Specialization
courses.desc: A complete path that covers Python syntax, data structures, object-oriented programming, testing, and building small applications. Good for learners who want structured progression from basics to practical scripting.

courses.title: Full Stack Web Development with React
courses.desc: Project-driven specialization focusing on HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React for front-end, Node.js/Express for back-end, REST APIs and database integration. Includes deployment and a capstone web application project.

courses.title: Android App Development with Kotlin
courses.desc: Google-backed learning paths and nanodegree-style courses teaching Kotlin, Android SDK, Jetpack components, UI design patterns, and publishing to the Play Store — designed for new Android developers.

courses.title: Flutter & Dart - The Complete Guide
courses.desc: Hands-on course for building cross-platform mobile apps with Flutter and Dart: widgets, state management, routing, backend integration, and production deployment. Includes sample apps and UI best practices.

courses.title: AWS Cloud Practitioner Essentials
courses.desc: Introductory AWS training covering cloud concepts, AWS core services (EC2, S3, Lambda), basic security, and pricing. Good starting point before deeper AWS certification paths.

courses.title: Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer
courses.desc: Comprehensive preparation for data engineering on Google Cloud Platform: data pipelines, BigQuery, data processing, operationalization and ML model deployment — includes hands-on labs on GCP.

courses.title: Docker and Kubernetes: The Practical Guide
courses.desc: Practical course that teaches containerization with Docker and orchestration with Kubernetes: images, volumes, networking, deployments and scaling microservices in production-grade environments.

courses.title: DevOps on AWS
courses.desc: Understand DevOps culture and tools using AWS: CI/CD pipelines, CodePipeline, CodeBuild, infrastructure as code with CloudFormation and automation best practices for production delivery.

courses.title: Google UX Design Professional Certificate
courses.desc: End-to-end UX program teaching user research, wireframing, prototyping in Figma, usability testing, and portfolio creation—geared toward career changers aiming for junior UX roles.

courses.title: UI / UX Design Specialization
courses.desc: Comprehensive course sequence covering design thinking, interaction design, prototyping, testing and building design systems. Emphasizes a portfolio-first approach with case studies.

courses.title: Interaction Design Foundation: Visual Design
courses.desc: Practical modules on visual hierarchy, typography, color, layout and UI components taught by experienced designers. Focuses on design fundamentals that improve user comprehension and conversion.

courses.title: Digital Marketing Specialization
courses.desc: End-to-end digital marketing program: SEO, content marketing, social media, analytics, and paid advertising. Includes practical templates for campaign execution and growth experiments.

courses.title: Meta Social Media Marketing Professional Certificate
courses.desc: Practical training from Meta covering content strategy, ad campaign setup on Facebook & Instagram, audience targeting, measurement and creative testing — tailored for social media marketers.

courses.title: SEO Specialization
courses.desc: In-depth coverage of on-page, off-page and technical SEO, keyword research, content optimization, and performance measurement. Real-world projects to improve organic traffic for websites.

courses.title: Google Ads Search Certification (Skillshop)
courses.desc: Official Google Ads training on search campaigns, match types, bidding strategies and conversion tracking. Good for marketers who manage PPC campaigns and optimize ad ROI.

courses.title: Foundations of Business Strategy
courses.desc: Course on business strategy basics: competitive advantage, value proposition, market analysis and strategic frameworks to evaluate and build business models.

courses.title: Startup: Launching an Innovative Business
courses.desc: Practical course covering idea validation, MVP building, product-market fit, go-to-market strategies, and early-stage growth tactics — ideal for founders and solo builders.

courses.title: Finance for Non-Finance Professionals
courses.desc: Core financial concepts explained in plain language: financial statements, budgeting, valuation basics and KPIs useful for managers and founders to make data-driven decisions.

courses.title: Notion Mastery: Productivity and GTD
courses.desc: Practical workflows to use Notion for note-taking, project management, personal knowledge base and team collaboration — includes templates and customization tips to scale productivity.

courses.title: Microsoft Excel - Advanced
courses.desc: Advanced training in Excel including formulas, Power Query, pivot tables, macros and automation to create dashboards and speed up repetitive business tasks.

courses.title: Power BI Data Visualization
courses.desc: Learn data modeling, DAX basics, and building interactive dashboards with Power BI to create business intelligence reports for stakeholders.

courses.title: Cybersecurity Fundamentals
courses.desc: Introduction to cybersecurity principles: threat modeling, network security basics, common attack vectors and defensive strategies. Ideal for IT professionals starting in security.

courses.title: Ethical Hacking / Penetration Testing
courses.desc: Hands-on introduction to penetration testing methodologies, reconnaissance, exploitation and remediation. Teaches responsible disclosure and ethical practices.

courses.title: Network Security & Administration
courses.desc: Practical networking fundamentals with a security focus: routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs and monitoring tools to manage secure enterprise networks.

courses.title: Graphic Design Specialization
courses.desc: Covers typography, image composition, color theory, branding and practical workflows with design tools like Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator or Canva — includes portfolio projects.

courses.title: Video Editing for Social Media
courses.desc: Practical editing techniques for short-form content: pacing, transitions, color grading, sound design and export settings optimized for platforms like YouTube and TikTok.

courses.title: Motion Graphics with After Effects
courses.desc: Animation fundamentals, keyframe techniques and After Effects workflows to build motion assets, intros, and animated social media content.

courses.title: E-commerce Essentials: Shopify
courses.desc: Hands-on guide to set up a Shopify store, manage products, payments, shipping, and marketing fundamentals to start an online retail business.

courses.title: Amazon FBA Selling
courses.desc: Practical course on selling on Amazon using the FBA model: product research, sourcing, listing optimization, PPC basics and inventory management strategies.

courses.title: Affiliate Marketing Strategy
courses.desc: Step-by-step guide to building content funnels, choosing affiliate niches, conversion-focused content and tracking for monetization via affiliate programs.

courses.title: Freelancing Foundations: Pitch & Pricing
courses.desc: Learn how to create proposals, price services, onboard clients, manage scope and retain clients long-term — practical guidance for new freelancers.

courses.title: LinkedIn Profile & Personal Branding
courses.desc: Optimize LinkedIn profile, build a professional network, create content that attracts recruiters and clients, and use LinkedIn features for job search and lead generation.

courses.title: Resume & Interview Masterclass
courses.desc: Create ATS-friendly resumes, craft compelling cover letters and master interview techniques with practical role-play and answer frameworks to increase hiring success.

courses.title: Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate
courses.desc: Skill-focused certificate teaching data cleaning, analysis, visualization, R and SQL fundamentals, along with real case projects to prepare learners for entry-level data analyst roles.

courses.title: Tableau for Data Visualization
courses.desc: Learn to create dashboards, use connectors, calculate fields and present insights via interactive visualizations using Tableau Desktop and Tableau Public.

courses.title: Applied Machine Learning in Python
courses.desc: Practical ML course focusing on Python tools (scikit-learn), model selection, cross-validation, pipelines and deployment-ready modeling approaches for production scenarios.

courses.title: Natural Language Processing (NLP)
courses.desc: Core NLP concepts: tokenization, embeddings, sequence models, transformers, sentiment analysis, and practical projects building chatbots and text classifiers.

courses.title: Computer Vision with TensorFlow
courses.desc: Learn image processing, CNNs, object detection, segmentation, and practical deployment of computer vision models using TensorFlow and related tools.

courses.title: Java Programming and Software Engineering Fundamentals
courses.desc: Sequence of courses teaching Java, data structures, software engineering practices and project-based assignments to prepare for backend and application development roles.

courses.title: Modern JavaScript From The Beginning
courses.desc: Comprehensive practical JavaScript course covering ES6+, asynchronous programming, DOM manipulation, and building interactive web applications.

courses.title: Microsoft Azure Fundamentals
courses.desc: Official Azure foundational training covering cloud concepts, core Azure services, pricing, security and compliance — a starting point for Azure certifications and cloud roles.

courses.title: Serverless Machine Learning with AWS Lambda
courses.desc: Integration-focused course showing how to serve ML models using serverless architectures, AWS Lambda, API Gateway and monitoring to create scalable inference endpoints.

courses.title: Prototyping and Design Systems (Figma)
courses.desc: Hands-on course teaching Figma workflows, design systems, prototyping, and collaborative design processes used in product teams to ship consistent UI components.
